worldFact.fact: At 5,100 metres above sea level, the Andean gold-mining town of La Rinconada is the highest permanent settlement on Earth. Its people live and dig for gold in air holding around 50% less oxygen than at sea level, and the town boomed as gold prices soared between 2001 and 2009.
